auditMetadata.reportTitle: Architecture Explorer Phase 2 Runtime Verification & Evidence-Based Closure Audit Results

environmentProvenance.explorerNodeModules: Installed via npm --prefix explorer ci (exit code 0)

issues.title: Constellation filtering in the asynchronous worker path
issues.workstream: Workstream A: PBIM Performance and Benchmark Reliability
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Worker path must apply identical Constellation node/edge filtering as synchronous fallback path.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/test/static-constellation-projection.test.ts src/lib/adapters/component-constellation-adapter.test.ts && node scripts/test-worker-geometry-contract.cjs
issues.missingCoverage: Real-browser Web Worker thread IPC under Chrome DOM (Playwright browser binaries missing).
issues.evidenceSummary: 100% FeatureRegion parity and identical Constellation filtering verified across worker and main thread scripts in Vitest and CLI tests.

issues.title: Cross-mode position contamination
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Layout node positions must be scoped per architecture mode without leaking across mode transitions.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/test/Phase1F_PositionPersistenceContract.test.ts
issues.missingCoverage: None. Scoped layoutPositions and layoutProvenances verified.
issues.evidenceSummary: 7/7 Vitest regression tests pass verifying mode-scoped layoutPositions isolation and migration.

issues.title: Shared position inheritance in layout engine
issues.workstream: Workstream C: Geometry and Layout Correctness
issues.acceptanceCriteria: computeArchitectureLayoutWithMetadata must not copy or inherit existingPositions from previous layout modes.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/test/def01-position-isolation.test.ts
issues.evidenceSummary: 4/4 Vitest position-isolation tests pass confirming DEF-01 stale fallback loops removed.

issues.title: Legacy flat-position migration ambiguity
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Migration predicate in mergeWithDefaultState must distinguish uninitialized map from intentionally empty map.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/lib/projectState.test.ts
issues.evidenceSummary: 11/11 Vitest state tests pass verifying dual migration predicate in mergeWithDefaultState.

issues.title: Project-switch in-memory state isolation
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Switching active project must purge in-memory graph state and re-initialize mode layout maps.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/context/ProjectContext.test.tsx && node scripts/test-multi-project.cjs
issues.evidenceSummary: 9/9 Vitest context tests and 10/10 CLI multi-project regression tests pass verifying state isolation.

issues.title: Worker versus synchronous fallback parity
issues.workstream: Workstream A: PBIM Performance and Benchmark Reliability
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Worker layout engine and synchronous main-thread fallback engine must produce bit-for-bit identical coordinates.
issues.testCommand: node scripts/test-worker-geometry-contract.cjs && cd explorer && npx vitest run src/lib/adapters/component-constellation-adapter.test.ts
issues.missingCoverage: Live browser worker failure fallback execution in Chrome Playwright.
issues.evidenceSummary: CLI parity harness verifies 100% coordinate parity, but live browser worker termination fallback remains unexecuted.

issues.title: Static/interactive layout switch position authority
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Switching between static and interactive modes must respect position authority policy without unwanted auto-layout.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/lib/position-policy.test.ts src/components/GraphView.positionAuthority.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: 55 total Vitest tests pass verifying shouldAutoLayout('static', 'mode-switch') and position authority hierarchy.

issues.title: Single-click side effects before double-click handling
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Single-click selection side effects must be debounced to prevent interfering with double-click expansion.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx src/components/GraphView.runtimeIntegration.test.tsx
issues.missingCoverage: Real browser double-tap/double-click gesture event timing in Chrome DOM (Playwright browser binaries missing).
issues.evidenceSummary: Click debouncing and event isolation implemented and passing in Vitest jsdom, but real Chrome gesture timing is unexecuted.

issues.title: Duplicate activation from accessible-list keyboard handling
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard Enter and Space keydown events must not trigger duplicate selection callbacks on list items.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/Phase1G_B_DisclosureAccessibility.test.tsx src/test/PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Refactored to native <button type="button"> with single onClick handler, verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Edge deselection incomplete in fallback path
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Deselecting a node or clicking empty canvas must clear selected edge highlights across all layout mode paths.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx src/components/GraphView.runtimeIntegration.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Unified background click and edge deselection handlers verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Selection exclusivity & cross-view synchronization
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Selection state must remain synchronized across graph view, accessible node list, and side drawer without state duplication.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/context/SelectionContext.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: SelectionContext decoupled state provider verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Workspace lens/surface capability mismatch
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Workspace surfaces must declare capability flags matching supported layout modes.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/test/WorkspaceRegistry.test.ts
issues.evidenceSummary: Explicit capability declarations per surface verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Zoom/pan configuration API contract
issues.workstream: Workstream C: Geometry and Layout Correctness
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Cytoscape zoom and pan bounds must conform to minZoom (0.1) and maxZoom (3.0) configuration contract.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx src/test/PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: minZoom: 0.1 and maxZoom: 3.0 configured and verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Stale double-tap callback references
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Touch gesture double-tap handlers must capture current state references without stale closures.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Stable ref pattern for gesture callbacks verified in Vitest rerender callback freshness test.

issues.title: Accessible graph node list scalability
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Accessible node list must render bounded top-50 items to prevent DOM freezing on 500+ node graphs.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/Phase1G_B_DisclosureAccessibility.test.tsx src/test/PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Top-50 truncation with search filter and selected-node inclusion verified on 528-node graph in Vitest.

issues.title: Drawer dependency list bounds
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Drawer dependency list must bound initial items and provide 'Show More' expansion for dense components.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/InvestigationDrawer.test.tsx src/test/PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: List truncation with 'Show More' toggle button verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Accessible names, roles, selected/pressed states
issues.acceptanceCriteria: All interactive controls must feature ARIA attributes (aria-selected, aria-pressed, aria-label) conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/Phase1C_Accessibility.test.tsx src/components/Phase1GA_KeyboardAccessibility.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: ARIA attributes (aria-selected, aria-pressed, aria-label) verified across view controls in Vitest.

issues.title: Capability-aware overlays & unsupported-mode states
issues.acceptanceCriteria: FeatureOverlayCanvas must hide feature region rects when active mode does not support feature overlays.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/test/PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx src/test/FeatureRegionOverlay.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Architecture mode capability check suppressing feature regions in hierarchical mode verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Animation-frame/event cleanup & long-session leaks
issues.acceptanceCriteria: All window event listeners, requestAnimationFrame calls, and timers must be cleared on component unmount.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx src/components/GraphView.positionAuthority.test.tsx
issues.missingCoverage: Long-session Playwright real-browser heap memory leak profiling in Chrome.
issues.evidenceSummary: Component unmount listener cleanup verified in Vitest, but long-session Chrome heap memory leak profiling is unexecuted.

issues.title: Graph update cost and unnecessary Cytoscape rebuilds
issues.workstream: Workstream A: PBIM Performance and Benchmark Reliability
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Updating node positions must re-use existing Cytoscape elements via cy.batch() without tearing down DOM graph.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx src/components/GraphView.runtimeIntegration.test.tsx

testCounts.graphView: 22/22 passed (element sync on same instance test passed)

issues.evidenceSummary: In-place position update path using same Cytoscape instance verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Rules-of-Hooks / conditional render reachability
issues.acceptanceCriteria: All React Hooks must be called unconditionally at top-level before any early return statements.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/test/WorkspaceRegistry.test.ts src/test/PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Unconditional Hook execution order across shell and workspace views verified in source code and Vitest render tests.

issues.title: Stale focus-origin after disable/re-enable
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Re-enabling investigation mode must reset stale focus origin from previous investigation session.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/context/InvestigationContext.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: InvestigationContext focus origin reset handler verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Connection / Impact exit traps
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Users must be able to exit connection or impact mode via Escape key binding or clear close UI button.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/ConnectionControls.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Escape key listener and close button actions verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Effect dependency omissions / stale graph state
issues.acceptanceCriteria: All useEffect hooks in GraphView.tsx must include complete, accurate dependency arrays.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/GraphView.test.tsx src/components/GraphView.runtimeIntegration.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: Complete dependency arrays across useEffect hooks verified in GraphView source code and Vitest integration tests.

issues.title: Loading / error / empty-state handling
issues.acceptanceCriteria: App shell must render loading spinners during dataset fetches and error boundaries on render exceptions.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx vitest run src/components/ErrorBoundary.test.tsx
issues.evidenceSummary: React ErrorBoundary and fallback UI rendering verified in Vitest.

issues.title: Type safety, depth parsing, loose types
issues.acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) must pass with zero type errors across types/explorer.ts.
issues.testCommand: cd explorer && npx tsc --noEmit
issues.evidenceSummary: 0 TypeScript compilation errors in types/explorer.ts contract definitions.
